messages:
lee: Opening a quick thread for tonight's cross-service deploy (API/runtime/console/router). Deploy-bot shows slot at 21:30 UTC. Main risks: saved-route schema change and runtime quant kernel tweak.

deploy-bot: Wave scheduled: wave-2026-03-15-E. Preflight note: console schema v2 needs router tolerant parsing. Runtime image quant-v2 passed unit but failed one perf regression test in staging.

harper: The perf regression hits long sequences only; fallback would be to pin runtime to quant-v1 for this wave. Alternatively we can add a runtime config to cap batch-size for a window.

nova: Router can add header-compat-mode=true for 12h. That avoids rejects while console migration flows. We should plan to remove flag after checks.

lee: Proposed plan: 1) flip router header-compat in canary, 2) apply runtime batch-size cap in canary, 3) run 15m synthetic long-seq test, 4) if good, proceed 10% -> 60% -> 100%. Rollback owners: @nova router, @harper runtime, @lee console.

harper: I'll apply runtime.batch.max_inflight=40 in canary and run stress.

ops-bot: Applied change cfg-9123: runtime.batch.max_inflight=40 on canary.

nova: Flipping router.flag header-compat-mode=true on canary. Change cfg-9124.

deploy-bot: Canary roll started. Monitoring for 10m.

ops-bot: Canary synthetic run: long-seq throughput stable, no perf regression observed. Router logs: <1% header warnings, no 4xx.

lee: Good. Ramp plan: 10% -> 60% in 12m -> 100% in 28m. Auto-abort: API 5xx >=0.8% or p95 increase >=120ms sustained 5m.

harper: Agree. We'll keep the batch cap in place until hotfix merges. I'll open ticket INF-3555 to track removal.

nova: I'll schedule router flag revert after 18h if nothing pops.

deploy-bot: Wave ramping to 60% now.

ops-bot: 60% snapshot: p95 +9ms, error-rate steady. No triggers.

lee: Proceed to 100%. Remember to add one-line note to release notes about temporary batch cap + router compat flag and owners.

deploy-bot: Wave completed to 100% at t+32m. No rollback triggered.

lee: Closing thread. Thanks all, follow-ups: INF-3555 (runtime cap removal), schedule router flag revert.
